definitions.explanation: A physical board where notices and announcements are posted.
An online platform where users can post and read messages.

examples.japanese: {掲示板|けいじばん}にお{知|し}らせが{貼|は}ってある。
examples.english: There's a notice posted on the bulletin board.

examples.japanese: {学校|がっこう}の{掲示板|けいじばん}を{確認|かくにん}してください。
examples.english: Please check the school bulletin board.

examples.japanese: インターネットの{掲示板|けいじばん}で{情報|じょうほう}を{集|あつ}める。
examples.english: I gather information on internet message boards.

notes:
{掲示板|けいじばん} combines {掲示|けいじ} (posting/notice) + {板|ばん} (board).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {掲示板|けいじばん}に{貼|は}る (to post on a bulletin board)
- {掲示板|けいじばん}を{見|み}る (to look at the bulletin board)
- ネットの{掲示板|けいじばん} (internet forum)

RELATED TERMS:
- {掲示|けいじ} (notice, posting)
- 電子{掲示板|けいじばん} (electronic bulletin board)
- BBS (ビービーエス - bulletin board system)

USAGE NOTES:
- Physical bulletin boards are common in schools, offices, and public buildings
- Online 掲示板 were very popular in Japan (e.g., 2ちゃんねる)
